edge: Include sv_vpi_user.h from a C++ translation unit.
negative: Attempt to build a VPI application when the simulator distribution does not provide sv_vpi_user.h.
notes: Materialization requires the simulator's supported VPI native-code build flow.
positive: Compile a VPI application that includes sv_vpi_user.h using the simulator-provided include search path.

edge: Compile separate uses of the failExpr and step alternatives of the detail union without assuming structure padding.
negative: Check a header with an omitted or differently typed structure member, callback parameter, return type, or registration parameter.
notes: Check declaration and member type compatibility; implementation-specific padding is not an oracle.
positive: Compile C source that initializes every listed structure and union member, checks the pointer typedef targets, assigns a matching function to vpi_assertion_callback_func, and type-checks a vpi_register_assertion_cb call.

edge: Check nonconsecutive lock/unlock and vacuous/nonvacuous action callback values.
negative: Check a header where any listed assertion callback-reason identifier is absent or numerically different.
positive: Compile static checks for every identifier in the assertion callback and assertion system callback sections.

edge: Check distinct per-assertion and assertion-system lock, action-enable, action-disable, and vacuity-control identifiers.
negative: Check a header where any listed assertion control identifier is absent or assigned a different integer.
positive: Compile static checks for every identifier in the assertion control constants section.

edge: Check thread/frame reasons 600 through 605 and object lifecycle reasons 700 through 702.
negative: Check a header where one callback-reason constant is absent or has a different integer.
positive: Compile static checks for all nine callback-reason constants in this source block.

edge: Verify both the backward-compatible vpiCoverMax name and vpiCoveredMax resolve to 766.
negative: Check a header where any listed coverage model identifier is absent or has a different integer value.
positive: Compile static checks for every listed coverage type, status, assertion-coverage, FSM-property, and FSM-handle identifier.

edge: Check both runtime control identifiers through vpiCoverageCheck and persistence identifiers vpiCoverageMerge and vpiCoverageSave.
negative: Check a header where a coverage-control identifier is absent or has a different value.
positive: Compile static checks for all six coverage-control identifiers and their consecutive values.

edge: Check that values reused by unrelated property categories remain available under each specified category-specific name.
negative: Check a header where any listed extended property identifier or value is absent or assigned a different integer.
notes: Numeric overlap across identifier categories is intentional.
positive: Compile static checks for every property identifier and enumerated value in this source block.

edge: Check that category-local reused values retain their distinct macro names.
negative: Check a header where any listed generic property identifier or enumerated value is missing or numerically different.
notes: Numeric overlap between different identifier categories is intentional.
positive: Compile static checks for every generic property identifier and enumerated value in this source block.

edge: Include sv_vpi_user.h after vpi_user.h and also as the first VPI header in separate translation units.
negative: Check a header variant with the inclusion guard, vpi_user.h inclusion, or conditional C-linkage wrapper removed.
notes: C001 opens the guard and C-linkage block; C006 supplies their required closing directives.
positive: Compile C and C++ translation units that include sv_vpi_user.h twice; in C++, link an Annex M function declaration against a C-linkage definition.

edge: Verify aliases such as vpiVarBit, vpiLogicVar, vpiArrayVar, and vpiArrayNet resolve to their specified base identifiers.
negative: Check a header where any listed object/type macro is absent, has a different integer, or resolves to a different base VPI identifier.
notes: Alias checks use vpi_user.h from the same installation; repeated numbers in unrelated categories are permitted.
positive: Compile static checks for every object/type identifier and alias preceding the METHODS section.

edge: Check distinct encodings for overlapping and nonoverlapping implication/followed_by and for pre/post increment and decrement.
negative: Check a header where any listed VPI operator identifier is missing or assigned a different integer.
positive: Compile static checks for every operator identifier from vpiImplyOp through vpiAssignmentOp.

edge: Verify qualifier flags retain their bit values and deprecated vpiValidUnknown remains defined as 2.
negative: Check a header where any listed property or enumerated value is absent or numerically different.
notes: Retained compatibility names remain part of the normative header.
positive: Compile static checks for every property identifier and value in this block outside the Operators and CALLBACK REASONS sections.

edge: Verify vpiConcurrentAssertions aliases vpiConcurrentAssertion and vpiInstance remains available for both relationship cardinalities.
negative: Check a header where any listed relationship macro is missing, numerically different, or aliases a different identifier.
positive: Compile static checks for every traversal relationship identifier in the METHODS section.
